subject: SKU aggregation causing duplicate marketplace line items - triage
messages:
From: aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts@acmerobotics.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice 5219 - duplicate SKU lines

Hi Vanessa,

We ran an automated reconciliation against the seller listing for Acme Robotics and flagged a high rate of duplicate SKU aggregation on invoice 5219. The attached usage export shows the raw meter lines that were rolled up; some identical SKU IDs were aggregated twice for the same billing window when the seller published a corrected listing mid-cycle.

Attached: usage-export-20271001.csv, aws-listing-report-20271001.csv

We can either issue a credit memo to the buyer or reissue the invoice after correcting the aggregation. Before we proceed, can you confirm which internal ledger (merchant vs. marketplace-reconciled) you want the adjustment posted to, and whether we should include VAT on the credit lines?

Thanks,
Alexa Ruiz
AWS Marketplace Billing Operations
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, accounts@acmerobotics.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice 5219 - duplicate SKU lines

Alexa — thanks for the heads up and the exports. Looping in Jonas (billing ops) and Marissa (finance) to confirm ledger posting and Grace for VAT treatment. Quick answers to help triage:

- We prefer reissuing a corrected invoice where possible, but if reissue will delay settlement beyond next payout window, please proceed with a credit memo and tag it to the marketplace-reconciled ledger.
- For VAT: flag for review — Grace, quick call out on whether the credit should include VAT (Acme is EU-registered but invoice shows UK VAT charged).

Jonas / Marissa / Grace: can you take a look at the CSVs Alexa attached and confirm next steps? If we go with a credit memo, we need: credit amount, VAT treatment, and a target posting ledger.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, accounts@acmerobotics.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 14:23:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice 5219 - duplicate SKU lines

Thanks—I pulled the usage-export and ran a quick dedupe against our SKU mapping. Findings:

- Root cause: seller published listing v2 on 2027-10-01 03:17 UTC. Our aggregation job picked up both the pre- and post-correction usage tags because the listing GUID changed but the seller reused the same external SKU label. That created two distinct internal SKU keys that were both billed.
- Exposure: net overcharge on invoice 5219 is $4,730.12.
- Recommended action: issue a credit memo for $4,730.12 against invoice 5219, post to marketplace-reconciled ledger, and apply to next settlement for Acme. Also update SKU mapping to alias the old GUID to the new GUID to prevent future duplication.

Attachments: reconciliation-checklist.txt (internal) — I included the mapping snippet in the Drive doc in case you want the code diff.

Marissa — confirm that posting to marketplace-reconciled is acceptable from a revenue recognition perspective and whether we need a reissued invoice instead. Grace — VAT decision below?

Jonas Weber
Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, accounts@acmerobotics.com
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 08:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice 5219 - duplicate SKU lines

Short VAT note: Acme provided UK VAT number GB123456789. Because the original invoice charged UK VAT and the overcharge occurred in the same billing period, the credit memo should include a VAT reversal line (i.e., the credit amount net of VAT and a VAT adjustment line). For our records, we need the seller's VAT evidence and the original invoice breakdown by tax amount.

Action items for external: please attach the original invoice PDF (acme-invoice-5219.pdf) and confirm whether the credit memo will be VAT-inclusive or if you'll provide separate VAT adjustment lines.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Tax Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference
From: accounts@acmerobotics.com (Samir Patel)
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, aws-marketplace-billing@amazon.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2027 10:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice 5219 - duplicate SKU lines

Thanks everyone — we appreciate the quick triage. Per your request, attached are: acme-invoice-5219.pdf and our internal ledger export (attachment: acme-ledger-export-20271001.csv). We confirm the VAT number in the invoice is correct and Acme prefers a credit memo applied to the next payout rather than a reissued invoice.

Please proceed with the credit memo inclusive of VAT reversal lines (as Grace suggested). Let us know ETA for the credit posting and any paperwork we need to sign.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of Finance — Acme Robotics
